tours.overview: An intimate photography workshop deep in the Sundarbans, the world's largest mangrove delta and home to the Royal Bengal Tiger. Limited to 9 participants to ensure personal mentorship and minimal wildlife disturbance.

itinerary.title: Arrival & Orientation
itinerary.description: Report at Science City, Kolkata at 16:00. Depart for Gadkhali with tour orientation en route. Reach the homestay by 21:00 followed by dinner.

itinerary.title: Full-Day Boat Safari
itinerary.description: Pre-dawn reporting at 04:45. From 05:00 to 16:30, enjoy a full-day boat safari in the tiger reserve area with meals served onboard. Return to the homestay at 17:00. Evening review and post-processing sessions from 18:30 to 20:45, followed by dinner at 21:00.

itinerary.title: Second Full-Day Safari
itinerary.description: Same schedule as Day 2: reporting at 04:45, boat safari from 05:00 to 16:30 with meals onboard, return at 17:00, evening review sessions, and dinner at 21:00.

itinerary.title: Final Safari & Departure
itinerary.description: Room check-out at 04:45 followed by reporting. Full-day boat safari from 05:00 to 16:30 with meals onboard. Return to Gadkhali Ferry-Ghat at 17:30 and prepare for departure. Dispersal at Science City, Kolkata at 21:30.

tours.accommodation: Homestay rooms are air‑conditioned with attached toilets and geysers, allotted on a double‑occupancy basis. A common electric kettle is available, and guests are advised to carry personal towels for hygiene.
tours.meals: Freshly cooked meals are served on the boat, featuring local delicacies of fish, prawns, and crabs, with chicken at dinner. Purified drinking water is provided at both the lodge and boat, avoiding small plastic bottles to reduce pollution.
tours.transportation: Guests report at Science City, Kolkata, and travel together to Gadkhali with orientation provided en route. All safaris are conducted on well‑equipped boats, with return transfers arranged to the homestay and back to Kolkata at the end of the trip.
thingsToCarry: Cotton loose clothes in matte colours
Small backpack with medicines and essentials
Torch or headlamp for darker hours
importantNotes: Location is Sundarban Tiger Reserve, accessible via Kolkata airport or Canning station.
Dates are 8th to 11th September 2026 with three full‑day boat safaris.
Cost is INR 15,000 including safaris, transfers, meals, and accommodation.
Accommodation is in air‑conditioned homestays with basic amenities, meals mainly local delicacies.
Photography learning sessions cover light, composition, post‑processing, and field techniques.
Recommended equipment includes DSLR, telephoto lens (400mm+), wide‑angle lens, spare batteries and cards.
Essentials to carry include cotton clothes, cap/hat, sunglasses, electrolytes, torch, insect repellent, and ID card.

bookingInfo.cancellationPolicy: Full refund up to 30 days before start. 50% refund between 15–30 days. No refund within 14 days.
